title: Operating Lines of Credit Overadvance Pricing for Deep Use of the Tolerance
content:
An Operating Lines of Credit overadvance that uses most of the line's overadvance tolerance is priced higher than one that uses little of it.

## Rule

Measured against the line's overadvance tolerance — the product's overadvance tolerance percentage of the commitment — points are added to the fee percentage as follows:

- **0.5 points** when the overadvance portion is at least 0.75 of the tolerance;
- **0.25 points** when it is at least 0.5 of the tolerance but below 0.75 of it;
- **nothing** when it is below 0.5 of the tolerance.

The overadvance portion is the advance amount less the available credit immediately before it, never less than zero. The points are added to the fee percentage itself, and the percentage so raised is the one the overadvance portion is multiplied by.

## Tolerance by product

| Product | Overadvance tolerance (% of commitment) |
|---|---|
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 5 |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 7.5 |
| StartRight Operating Line, ExpressLine Operating Credit, Seasonal Operating Loan, Revolving Operating Line | 0 (no overadvance permitted) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical Borrowing Base Operating Line, commitment USD 2,000,000, so a tolerance of USD 100,000)

| Overadvance portion | Share of the tolerance | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| USD 75,000.00 | 0.75 | 0.5 |
| USD 74,999.99 | just below 0.75 | 0.25 |
| USD 50,000.00 | 0.5 | 0.25 |
| USD 49,999.99 | just below 0.5 | None |

On an Agribusiness Revolving Line with the same commitment the tolerance is USD 150,000, so 0.5 points begin at an overadvance portion of USD 112,500 and 0.25 points at USD 75,000.
